task_message:
Case F29: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 251x251x435 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case F29 is finished. 

**Summary:** The fibrous soft-tissue tumor presented as a long, T2-hyperintense heterogeneous mass with internal dark septations running along the femur in the thigh, extending roughly 19 cm craniocaudally. I seeded the mass with a positive point on the brightest lobule (axial 190), verified the multi-plane extent, resisted several over-inclusive model expansions (point/lasso prompts flooded into vessels, fat, and fluid tracts and were undone), and finalized the v4 mask, which adds a 2 mm peripheral dilation to capture the lesion's rim. The final review showed no lesion beyond the mask ends; the automatic candidates were rejected as surrounding normal fat/muscle. Final volume 229.5 mL, saved with medium confidence.
